connector.name: 24htrack MCP
connector.registryDescription: Track packages across 3,200+ carriers (USPS, UPS, FedEx, DHL & more) with auto carrier detection.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package 24htrack-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ngkienmkqn account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: TRACK24H_API_KEY
env.description: 24hTrack API key — create one free at https://www.24htrack.com (Developer Settings). Optional at startup: the server boots and exposes its tool list without it (so keyless registry health-checks pass); tool CALLS return a guided auth error until it is set.
